title: Magic Brush
copy: Refine a cutout with Erase and Restore. Choose a brush size and correct the result before you download.

title: for Individuals
copy: Make profile pictures, personal projects and creative cutouts with a transparent or colored background.

title: for Photographers
copy: Isolate your subject, compare the original and result, and export a PNG for your next editing step.

title: for Marketing
copy: Prepare clean image assets for social posts, presentations and campaign layouts.

title: for Developers
copy: Download transparent assets for websites and interfaces. Clearcut does not currently offer a public API.

title: for Ecommerce
copy: Give product photos a consistent white background and export them without a watermark.

title: for Media
copy: Create image cutouts for editorial layouts and visual storytelling, using photos you have permission to edit.

title: for Car Dealerships
copy: Try a clean background for vehicle photos. Complex reflections and fine edges may need manual refinement.

title: for Enterprise
copy: Explore the browser-based workflow for your team. Enterprise administration and bulk processing are not available yet.
